about: Branches of the user's memory: each project scope belongs to one domain, by the first pattern (fnmatch) that matches it. Recall and timeline take scope='domain:<name>' to search one branch; the profile groups projects by domain. A scope no pattern matches is in 'other'. Classified by Claude on 8 Oct 2026; edit freely, then redeploy.
